title: ticfac run's herdr panes drop runners.toml effort, args and socket: run-epic builds executorFactory with an empty gate path
description:
run never forwards --gate, and cli.go:339 captures *fl.gate ("") in executorFactory before reconcile defaults GateConfig to .tick/runners.toml. spawnArgv reads "", treats ENOENT as 'routes nothing', and launches claude without effort, pi without the --approve init writes, and at the default socket even when orchestration.socket is where run detected herdr. Pre-existing in executor.go, but ticfac run makes it the default path.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding d1fd2267c6ff8d2ff491b7c0f4d4821663cb9a7d3395a05f84a2e5de9931a522 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/d1fd2267c6ff8d2ff491b7c0f4d4821663cb9a7d3395a05f84a2e5de9931a522.json on the run branch.
